// diagnostic E3113

Jet.RawMemoryOutsideKernel

`{operation}` is a raw memory operation outside the package's memory kernel

What

`{operation}` is a raw memory operation outside the package's memory kernel

Why

Raw memory operations stand only in the kernel files `policy.memory` names, so the package's memory safety is audited in one place.

Fix

Outside the kernel, read and write through a `[T]` list or a `View<T>` a kernel owner hands out; to make `{path}` a kernel file, add it to `policy: { memory: .Kernel([...]) }` in `package.jet`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.RawMemoryOutsideKernel: Tests/UI/E3113PackageWithoutKernelFiles/stderr.

Error: Jet.RawMemoryOutsideKernel: `alloc_raw` is a raw memory operation outside the package's memory kernel
  --> Tests/UI/E3113PackageWithoutKernelFiles/run.jet:7:35
    |
  7 | _grab: fn() -> mem.Ptr<U8>? { mem.alloc_raw(16, 8) }
    |                                   ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Raw memory operations stand only in the kernel files `policy.memory` names, so the package's memory safety is audited in one place.
 Fix: Outside the kernel, hold the memory in a `[T]` list or an owner a kernel file hands out; to make `run.jet` a kernel file, name the package's kernel files in `package.jet`: `policy: { memory: .Kernel(["run.jet"]) }`.
